title: This AI startup says it can generate permit-ready blueprints in minutes
slides: Meet the AI startup claiming permit-ready blueprints in minutes. Can it deliver?
It uses deep learning to interpret building codes automatically.
But its output may fail on complex sites, experts warn.
Contractors can now beta-test it, but accuracy claims remain unverified.
Try one real project: verify every line before you trust it.
thread_text:
1. Permit-Ready in Minutes?

An AI startup claims its deep learning tool can turn building codes into permit-ready blueprints. Contractors can now beta-test it, but accuracy remains unverified.

2. Building Codes, Decoded

The system interprets complex building regulations automatically, aiming to slash the weeks-long permitting process to just minutes.

3. Complex Sites, Big Risks

Experts warn the AI's output may fail on intricate sites, where subtle code nuances and site-specific constraints trip up even experienced human reviewers.

4. Beta Test, But Beware

Contractors jumping into the beta must manually verify every line. One error could mean rejected permits, costly rework, or worse—unsafe structures.

5. Verify Every Line

Try it on one real project and check every single line before you trust it. If the tool saves hours but costs accuracy, is it worth the risk?
